name: Unified
subtitle: Private messaging across every network.
description: Install and update the Unified iOS app directly through SideStore.

apps.name: Unified
apps.subtitle: All your private chats in one inbox.
apps.localizedDescription: Unified brings your private messaging networks together through your own private Hub.

versions.localizedDescription: Chats open at the newest message. History paging fills gaps in sparse cached messages. Connected account labels stay stable without changing message destinations.
Separate Codes and Requests tabs alongside Inbox, Archive, Low Priority, and Merged Chats. Provider-confirmed requests and verification-code-only conversations are organized automatically.
Videos stay paused until tapped, then open and play fullscreen. Closed chats cancel pending media downloads so new media can load sooner.
Fix live synchronization after idle responses and automatic recovery when the desktop history cache fills.
Coordinated release with automatic recovery for frozen desktop live updates and sent indicators.
Compact inline Instagram reels, swipe to reveal sent times, cleaner Instagram read receipts, and a centered composer icon.
Reliable sending: preserve pending messages through connection timeouts, retry safely, and keep attachment loading from delaying messages.
Stabilizes swipe-to-archive and swipe-to-reply, and makes inline video previews substantially more compact.
Preserves the private Hub pairing across SideStore updates with a validated, device-local recovery path.
Improved the iOS inbox and conversation layouts, updated Unified branding, and included the latest messaging and media fixes.

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Allow Unified to unlock this device session.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Unified to record voice notes you choose to send.
